_meta.task: Verify vendor (datasheet) parameters for Coilcraft 1812CS ceramic-core RF inductors
_meta.working_context: 31 MHz loaded 1 m short monopole antenna; project D:\实验报告文件夹\电路2, stage_am_alt3_4
_meta.primary_source: Coilcraft Document 105 (Rev 08/08/22) - official 1812CS datasheet PDF, downloaded and text-extracted; cross-checked against the live product pages.
_meta.secondary_source: Coilcraft Document 158 (SPICE models) - kept strictly separate as TYPICAL/de-embedded, never as guarantee.

kind_legend.guaranteed: Datasheet VALUE with a min/max or explicit spec that Coilcraft commits to.
kind_legend.typical: Value published by Coilcraft but explicitly labelled typical / de-embedded / model-derived.
kind_legend.derived: Computed BY THIS TASK from published model element values. Not printed by Coilcraft anywhere.

coilcraft_doc158_spice_1812cs.pdf (68958 bytes, Document 158, 2 pages, verified %PDF magic)
vendor_1812cs_html_extract.txt (verbatim table + notes text scraped from the product pages)
_meta.access_notes: coilcraft.com returns HTTP 403 to plain Invoke-WebRequest/web_fetch on the table region (>100k HTML truncated). Pages and PDFs were retrieved with curl.exe using a browser User-Agent; the full 210 KB HTML was parsed locally. PDFs were text-extracted with pypdf and visually verified by rendering both pages.

alternative_vendors_verified.evidence_quote: "IMC1812ES3R3K 3.3 ± 10 % 7.96 50 45.0 0.80 355" under header "IND. (μH) TOL. TEST FREQ. (MHz) Q MIN. SRF MIN. (MHz) DCR MAX. (Ω) RATED DC CURRENT (mA)"
alternative_vendors_verified.verdict: NOT a substitute for our use. Coilform material is 'powdered iron for 1.0 uH to 120 uH' (not ceramic). SRF min is only 45 MHz at 3.3 uH (1.45x our 31 MHz) vs 145 MHz for 1812CS-332. Q min is specified at 7.96 MHz, not at 31 MHz. Rated DC current is on a 40 C rise at 85 C ambient, a different basis from Coilcraft's 15 C rise.

alternative_vendors_verified.document: TDK product page (official product.tdk.com data, served via product.tdk.cn)
alternative_vendors_verified.evidence_quote: "电感 3.3μH ±5% at 10MHz" ; "自我共振频率 [Min.] 60MHz" ; "自我共振频率 [Typ.] 90MHz" ; "Q [Min.] 45 at 10MHz" ; "Q [Typ.] 70 at 10MHz" ; "直流电阻 [Max.] 600mΩ" ; "使用温度范围 -55～125°C" ; "AEC-Q200 YES"
alternative_vendors_verified.verdict: NOT comparable. It is a FERRITE-core shielded multilayer in 0805 body (2.00 x 1.25 x 1.25 mm), not a ceramic-core 1812 wirewound. key_finding.question: Do the datasheet Q test frequency and SRF conflict with the Document 158 model we used?
key_finding.short_answer: The Q test frequency does NOT conflict (no contradiction), but it is a SCOPE caveat. The SRF DOES conflict quantitatively: the Doc 158 model overstates SRF by 1.64x-1.81x versus the guaranteed minimum.
key_finding.answer_on_q_test_frequency: NO CONTRADICTION, but a SCOPE caveat. The datasheet guarantees Q min at 50 MHz (NOT 100 MHz) - this is ABOVE our 31 MHz operating point, so the guaranteed number does not directly apply at 31 MHz. Evaluating the Doc 158 model, Q rises monotonically from 31 to 50 MHz for every one of the five parts, so Q(31 MHz) is LOWER than Q(50 MHz). Measured gap between the 50 MHz guarantee and the model's 31 MHz Q: 1812CS-272 63 -> 60.5 (4.0% optimistic), 332 65 -> 64.3 (1.1%), 392 69 -> 68.1 (1.3%), 472 63 -> 59.7 (5.2%), 562 59 -> 63.9 (model is 8.3% HIGHER here, because this value's Q peaks between 50 and 100 MHz). So quoting 'Q >= 65' at 31 MHz for the 332 is optimistic by about 1%, and by about 5% for the 472.
key_finding.answer_on_srf: YES, A REAL QUANTITATIVE CONFLICT. The datasheet guaranteed MINIMUM SRF is materially LOWER than the SRF of the Doc 158 model, by 1.64x to 1.81x: 1812CS-272 160 vs 276.2 MHz (1.73x), 332 145 vs 251.8 (1.74x), 392 130 vs 233.2 (1.79x), 472 115 vs 208.5 (1.81x), 562 100 vs 164.2 (1.64x). The model always overstates SRF. This is precisely what Document 158 itself warns: 'Typically, the Self-Resonant Frequency (SRF) of the component model will be higher than the measurement of the component mounted on a circuit board' and 'the model results may be different from the data sheet specifications'. The mechanism is stated by Coilcraft too: 'The parasitic reactive elements of a circuit board or fixture will effectively lower the circuit resonant frequency'. In the model the shunt capacitance is the de-embedded value (0.118-0.165 pF), which understates the effective capacitance a real board presents.
key_finding.practical_impact_at_31mhz: NONE for the antenna loading calculation itself. Even the worst guaranteed SRF in the set (100 MHz for 1812CS-562) is 3.2x our 31 MHz, and the 332 is 4.7x. All five parts are far below self-resonance at 31 MHz, so the inductive (series L + R) representation is valid and the loaded-monopole result is not invalidated. The conflict is about margin accounting and about which number gets quoted, not about the validity of the 31 MHz model.
key_finding.recommendation: Quote the datasheet GUARANTEED values as the contractual numbers (SRF min, Q min @ 50 MHz, DCR max, Irms @ 15 C rise). Keep the Doc 158 model only for frequency-dependent simulation. Any Q reported at 31 MHz must be labelled derived-from-model (typical), never as a guarantee, and any SRF quoted for margin purposes must use the guaranteed minimum, not the model's resonance.
